verses.geez: ዛቲ፡ ዓቀበት፡ አበ፡ ዓለም፡ ዘተልሕኰ፡ ቅድመ፡ ባሕቲቱ፡ ተገቢሮ፡ ተማኅፀነቶ፡ ወአድኃነቶ፡ እምአበሳ፡ ርእሱ።
verses.translation: She preserved the first formed father of the world, that was created alone, and brought him out of his fall,

translations.lxx: She preserved the first formed father of the world, that was created alone, and brought him out of his fall,
translations.ron: Înţelepciunea a păzit pe primul om zidit de Dumnezeu ca să fie părintele neamului omenesc, atunci când a fost zidit întâiul.
translations.grk: Αὕτη πρωτόπλαστον πατέρα κόσμου μόνον κτισθέντα διεφύλαξε, καὶ ἐξείλατο αὐτὸν ἐκ παραπτώματος ἰδίου,

verses.geez: ወወሀበቶ፡ ኃይለ፡ ከመ፡ ይኰንን፡ ወየአኀዝ፡ ኵሎ።
verses.translation: and gave him power to rule all things.

translations.lxx: and gave him power to rule all things.
translations.ron: Ea l-a scos din păcatul lui şi i-a dat putere să stăpânească toată făptura.
translations.grk: ἔδωκέ τε αὐτῷ ἰσχὺν κρατῆσαι ἁπάντων.

verses.geez: ወሶበ፡ ርኅቀ፡ እምኔሃ፡ ዓማፂ፡ ወገፋዒ፡ በመዓት፡ ተኀጒለ፡ ምስለ፡ ነፍሳተ፡ ቀታልያነ፡ አኃው።
verses.translation: But when the unrighteous went away from her in his anger, he perished also in the fury wherewith he murdered his brother.

translations.lxx: But when the unrighteous went away from her in his anger, he perished also in the fury wherewith he murdered his brother.
translations.ron: Fiindcă s-a depărtat de ea, mâniindu-se, cel nedrept a pierit în nebunia sa ucigaşă de frate.
translations.grk: Ἀποστὰς δὲ ἀπʼ αὐτῆς ἄδικος ἐν ὀργῇ αὐτοῦ, ἀδελφοκτόνοις συναπώλετο θυμοῖς,

verses.geez: ወከማሁ፡ ካዕበ፡ ሶበ፡ ተአይኅ፡ ምድር፡ አድኀነቶ፡ ጥበብ፡ ወኃደፈቶ፡ ለጻድቅ፡ በንዋየ፡ ዕፅ፡ ምኑን።
verses.translation: For whose cause the earth being drowned with the flood, wisdom again preserved it, and directed the course of the righteous in a piece of wood of small value.

translations.lxx: For whose cause the earth being drowned with the flood, wisdom again preserved it, and directed the course of the righteous in a piece of wood of small value.
translations.ron: Iar când pământul a fost acoperit de ape, înţelepciunea l-a mântuit şi pe cel drept l-a purtat în slaba arcă de lemn.
translations.grk: διʼ ὃν κατακλυζομένην γῆν πάλιν διέσωσε σοφία, διʼ εὐτελοῦς ξύλου τὸν δίκαιον κυβερνήσασα.

verses.geez: ዛቲ፡ ሶበ፡ ተክዕዉ፡ አሕዛብ፡ ውስተ፡ ኅብረ፡ እከይ፡ ወጹግ፡ አመረቶ፡ ለጻድቅ፡ ወዓቀበቶ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ዘእንበለ፡ አበሳ፡ ወነውር፡ ወዓቀበት፡ ወልደ፡ ጽኑዐ፡ በምሕረት።
verses.translation: Moreover, the nations in their wicked conspiracy being confounded, she found out the righteous, and preserved him blameless unto God, and kept him strong against his tender compassion toward his son.

translations.lxx: Moreover, the nations in their wicked conspiracy being confounded, she found out the righteous, and preserved him blameless unto God, and kept him strong against his tender compassion toward his son.
translations.ron: Când popoarele şi-au amestecat nelegiuirile toate, de-a valma, înţelepciunea a ştiut pe cel drept şi l-a păstrat fără vină în faţa lui Dumnezeu şi l-a păzit nebiruit, când a fost să-l doboare mila de copilul său.
translations.grk: Αὕτη καὶ ἐν ὁμονοίᾳ πονηρίας ἐθνῶν συγχυθέντων εὗρε τὸν δίκαιον, καὶ ἐτήρησεν αὐτὸν ἄμεμπτον Θεῷ, καὶ ἐπὶ τέκνου σπλάγχνοις ἰσχυρὸν ἐφύλαξεν.

verses.geez: ዛቲ፡ ባልሐት፡ ወልደ፡ ጻድቀ፡ እምእለ፡ ይትኃጐሉ፡ ረሲዓን፡ ወአድኃነቶ፡ በጐይይ፡ ሶበ፡ ወረደት፡ እሳት፡ ዲበ፡ ኃምስቱ፡ አህጉር።
verses.translation: When the ungodly perished, she delivered the righteous man, who fled from the fire which fell down upon the five cities.

translations.lxx: When the ungodly perished, she delivered the righteous man, who fled from the fire which fell down upon the five cities.
translations.ron: Tot ea a mântuit pe cel drept din prăpădul celor răi şi el a fugit departe de focul coborât peste cele cinci cetăţi.
translations.grk: Αὕτη δίκαιον, ἐξαπολλυμένων ἀσεβῶν, ἐῤῥύσατο φυγόντα πῦρ καταβάσιον Πενταπόλεως·

verses.geez: እስከ፡ ይእዜ፡ ሀለወት፡ ስምዐ፡ እስከ፡ ዮም፡ እንዘ፡ ትጠይስ፡ ብድውታ፡ ወአትክልቲሃኒ፡ እመ፡ በጊዜሃ፡ ይፈርዩ፡ ዘኢኮኑ፡ ፍጹማነ።
verses.translation: Of whose wickedness, even to this day the waste land that smoketh is a testimony, and plants bearing fruit that never come to ripeness: and a standing pillar of salt is a monument of an unbelieving soul.

translations.lxx: Of whose wickedness, even to this day the waste land that smoketh is a testimony, and plants bearing fruit that never come to ripeness: and a standing pillar of salt is a monument of an unbelieving soul.
translations.ron: Şi ca dovadă, arătând nelegiuirea lor, acest ţinut pustiit fumegă şi azi, pomii dau roadă în afară de vreme şi un stâlp de sare se înalţă acolo, spre pomenirea necredinciosului suflet al femeii lui Lot.
translations.grk: οἷς ἐτὶ μαρτύριον τῆς πονηρίας καπνιζομένη καθέστηκε χέρσος, καὶ ἀτελέσιν ὥραις καρποφοροῦντα φυτά· ἀπιστοῦσης ψυχῆς μνημεῖον ἑστηκυῖα στήλη ἁλός.

verses.geez: ወነፍስ፡ እንተ፡ ኢአምነት፡ ዝክረ፡ ቆመት፡ ሐውልተ፡ ፄው፡ ዘያስተርኢ።
verses.translation: For regarding not wisdom, they gat not only this hurt, that they knew not the things which were good; but also left behind them to the world a memorial of their foolishness: so that in the things wherein they offended they could not so much as be hid.

translations.lxx: For regarding not wisdom, they gat not only this hurt, that they knew not the things which were good; but also left behind them to the world a memorial of their foolishness: so that in the things wherein they offended they could not so much as be hid.
translations.ron: Nu le-a păsat de înţelepciune şi de aceea n-au ştiut ce este binele şi au lăsat celor care sunt în viaţă amintirea nebuniei lor, aşa încât ticăloşiile lor să nu fie înghiţite de uitare,
translations.grk: Σοφίαν γὰρ παροδεύσαντες οὐ μόνον ἐβλάβησαν τοῦ μὴ γνῶναι τὰ καλὰ, ἀλλὰ καὶ τῆς ἀφροσύνης ἀπέλιπον τῷ βίῳ μνημόσυνον, ἵνα ἐν οἷς ἐσφάλησαν μηδὲ λαθεῖν δυνηθῶσι.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ እልክቱ፡ እለ፡ ተዐደዉ፡ ትእዛዘ፡ አኮ፡ ከመ፡ ዘኃሥሩ፡ በአእምሮ፡ ርደተ፡ መዓት፡ እንተ፡ በጽሐቶሙ፡ አላ፡ ኀደጉ፡ ውስተ፡ ዓለም፡ ለዕበዶሙ፡ ዝክረ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይትከሃሎሙ፡ ኅብአተ፡ አበሳ፡ እንተ፡ አበሱ።
verses.translation: But wisdom delivered from pain those that attended upon her.

translations.lxx: But wisdom delivered from pain those that attended upon her.
translations.ron: Dar înţelepciunea a smuls din necazuri pe cei care sunt credincioşi.
translations.grk: Σοφία δὲ τοὺς θεραπεύσαντας αὐτὴν ἐκ πόνων ἐῤῥύσατο.

verses.geez: ጥበብሰ፡ ባልሐት፡ እለ፡ ይትለአክዋ፡ እምፃማ፡ ወሕማም።
verses.translation: When the righteous fled from his brother's wrath, she guided him in right paths, shewed him the kingdom of God, and gave him knowledge of holy things, made him rich in his travels, and multiplied the fruit of his labours.

translations.lxx: When the righteous fled from his brother's wrath, she guided him in right paths, shewed him the kingdom of God, and gave him knowledge of holy things, made him rich in his travels, and multiplied the fruit of his labours.
translations.ron: Iarăşi înţelepciunea a purtat pe căi drepte pe dreptul care fugea de mânia fratelui său, arătându-i împărăţia lui Dumnezeu şi dându-i învăţătură despre lucrurile sfinte; ea l-a îmbogăţit când el muncea din greu şi spor i-a dat în strădaniile lui.
translations.grk: Αὕτη φυγάδα ὀργῆς ἀδελφοῦ δίκαιον ὡδήγησεν ἐν τρίβοις εὐθείαις, ἔδειξεν αὐτῷ βασιλείαν Θεοῦ, καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ γνῶσιν ἁγίων, εὐπόρησεν αὐτὸν ἐν μόχθοις, καὶ ἐπλήθυνε τοὺς πόνους αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ዛቲ፡ መርሐት፡ ውስተ፡ ፍኖተ፡ ርትዕ፡ ጻድቀ፡ ዘጐየ፡ እምዓተ፡ እኁሁ፡ ወአርአየቶ፡ መንግሥተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ወወሀበቶ፡ አእምሮ፡ ቅዱሳን፡ ወአርኀበት፡ ሎቱ፡ ብዕሎ፡ እምፃማሁ።
verses.translation: In the covetousness of such as oppressed him she stood by him, and made him rich.

translations.lxx: In the covetousness of such as oppressed him she stood by him, and made him rich.
translations.ron: Înţelepciunea l-a sprijinit când a fost să-l jecmănească stăpânii hrăpăreţi şi l-a ajutat să dobândească mari averi.
translations.grk: Ἐν πλεονεξίᾳ κατισχύοντων αὐτὸν παρέστη, καὶ ἐπλούτισεν αὐτόν.

verses.geez: ወእምእለ፡ የኃይድዎ፡ ወይትኄየልዎ፡ ቆመት፡ ሎቱ።
verses.translation: She defended him from his enemies, and kept him safe from those that lay in wait, and in a sore conflict she gave him the victory; that he might know that godliness is stronger than all.

translations.lxx: She defended him from his enemies, and kept him safe from those that lay in wait, and in a sore conflict she gave him the victory; that he might know that godliness is stronger than all.
translations.ron: Ea l-a ferit de duşmani; ea l-a ocrotit de cei care îi întindeau curse; ea l-a făcut biruitor într-o luptă crâncenă, ca să-l înveţe că mai tare decât toate este cucernicia.
translations.grk: Διεφύλαξεν αὐτὸν ἀπὸ ἐχθρῶν, καὶ ἀπὸ ἐνεδρευόντων ἠσφαλίσατο, καὶ ἀγῶνα ἰσχυρὸν ἐβράβευσεν αὐτῷ, ἵνα γνῷ, ὅτι παντὸς δυνατωτέρα ἐστὶν εὐσέβεια.

verses.geez: ወረድአቶ፡ ወዓቀበቶ፡ ወተማኅፀነቶ፡ እምአዕራሪሁ፡ ወአድኀነቶ፡ እምእለ፡ ዐገትዎ፡ ወሠርዓቶ፡ አመ፡ ጸገወቶ፡ ገድለ፡ ጽኑዐ፡ ከመ፡ ያእምር፡ እስመ፡ ተቀንዮ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ በሠናይ፡ ይጸንዕ፡ እምኵሉ።
verses.translation: When the righteous was sold, she forsook him not, but delivered him from sin: she went down with him into the pit,

translations.lxx: When the righteous was sold, she forsook him not, but delivered him from sin: she went down with him into the pit,
translations.ron: Înţelepciunea n-a părăsit pe dreptul cel vândut, ci l-a ferit de păcat.
translations.grk: Αὕτη πραθέντα δίκαιον οὐκ ἐγκατέλιπεν, ἀλλὰ ἐξ ἁμαρτίας ἐῤῥύσατο αὐτόν·

verses.geez: ዛቲ፡ ኢኀደገት፡ ጽድቀ፡ ተሣይጦ፡ ወወረደት፡ ምስሌሁ፡ ውስተ፡ ግብፅ፡ ወአድኀነቶ፡ እምኀጢአት።
verses.translation: and left him not in bonds, till she brought him the sceptre of the kingdom, and power against those that oppressed him: as for them that had accused him, she shewed them to be liars, and gave him perpetual glory.

translations.lxx: and left him not in bonds, till she brought him the sceptre of the kingdom, and power against those that oppressed him: as for them that had accused him, she shewed them to be liars, and gave him perpetual glory.
translations.ron: Ea s-a coborât cu el în groapă şi în lanţurile lui nu l-a părăsit, până ce i-a dat sceptrul domniei şi puterea peste cei ce-l asupreau; ea a dovedit de minciună pe pârâşii lui şi i-a dat o veşnică mărire.
translations.grk: συγκατέβη αὐτῷ εἰς λάκκον, καὶ ἐν δεσμοῖς οὐκ ἀφῆκεν αὐτὸν, ἕως ἤνεγκεν αὐτῷ σκῆπτρα βασιλείας καὶ ἐξουσίαν τυραννούντων αὐτοῦ· ψευδεῖς τε ἔδειξε τοὺς μωμησαμένους αὐτὸν, καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ δόξαν αἰώνιον.

verses.geez: ወውስተ፡ ሙቃሔሑ፡ ኢኃደገቶ፡ እስከ፡ ሶበ፡ አምጽአት፡ ሎቱ፡ ሢመተ፡ መንግሥት፡ ወምልክና፡ ላዕለ፡ እለ፡ ተኃየልዎ።
verses.translation: She delivered the righteous people and blameless seed from the nation that oppressed them.

translations.lxx: She delivered the righteous people and blameless seed from the nation that oppressed them.
translations.ron: Înţelepciunea a izbăvit pe poporul cel cuvios şi seminţia cea nevinovată de neamurile care o împilau.
translations.grk: Αὕτη λαὸν ὅσιον καὶ σπέρμα ἄμεμπτον ἐῤῥύσατο ἐξ ἔθνους θλιβόντων.

verses.geez: ወከሠተት፡ ሐሰቶሙ፡ ለእለ፡ አንወርዎ፡ ወመነንዎ፡ ወወሀበቶ፡ ክብረ፡ ዘለዓለም።
verses.translation: She entered into the soul of the servant of the Lord, and withstood dreadful kings in wonders and signs;

translations.lxx: She entered into the soul of the servant of the Lord, and withstood dreadful kings in wonders and signs;
translations.ron: Ea a pătruns în sufletul robului lui Dumnezeu şi cu semne şi cu minuni ea a ţinut piept unor regi temuţi.
translations.grk: Εἰσῆλθεν εἰς ψυχὴν θεράποντος Κυρίου, καὶ ἀντέστη βασιλεῦσι φοβεροῖς ἐν τέρασι καὶ σημείοις.

verses.geez: ዛቲ፡ ባልሐት፡ ሕዝበ፡ ጻድቀ፡ ወዘርአ፡ ዘአልቦ፡ ነውር፡ ወኂስ፡ እምአሕዛብ፡ እለ፡ ያመነድቡ፡ በዊአ፡ ውስተ፡ ነፍሰ፡ ገብረ፡ እግዚአብሔር።
verses.translation: rendered to the righteous a reward of their labours, guided them in a marvellous way, and was unto them for a cover by day, and a light of stars in the night season;

translations.lxx: rendered to the righteous a reward of their labours, guided them in a marvellous way, and was unto them for a cover by day, and a light of stars in the night season;
translations.ron: Celor cuvioşi datu-le-a plata ostenelilor lor şi i-a călăuzit pe o cale preaminunată şi ziua le-a fost acoperământ şi noaptea lumină de stele;
translations.grk: Ἀπέδωκεν ὁσίοις μισθὸν κόπων αὐτῶν, ὡδήγησεν αὐτοὺς ἐν ὁδῷ θαυμαστῇ, καὶ ἐγένετο αὐτοῖς εἰς σκέπην ἡμέρας, καὶ εἰς φλόγα ἄστρων τὴν νύκτα.

verses.geez: ወተቃወመት፡ ነገሥተ፡ ብዙኃነ፡ በተአምራት፡ ወበመንክራት፡ ወወሀበቶሙ፡ ዐስበ፡ ፃማሆሙ።
verses.translation: brought them through the Red sea, and led them through much water:

translations.lxx: brought them through the Red sea, and led them through much water:
translations.ron: I-a trecut prin Marea Roşie şi i-a purtat prin ape mari.
translations.grk: Διεβίβασεν αὐτοὺς θάλασσαν ἐρυθρὰν, καὶ διήγαγεν αὐτοὺς διʼ ὕδατος πολλοῦ.

verses.geez: ወመርሐቶሙ፡ መንክረ፡ ወኮነቶሙ፡ በመዓልት፡ ጽላሎተ፡ ወበሌሊት፡ ህየንተ፡ ሥርቀተ፡ ከዋክብት፡ ጸዳለ።
verses.translation: but she drowned their enemies, and cast them up out of the bottom of the deep.

translations.lxx: but she drowned their enemies, and cast them up out of the bottom of the deep.
translations.ron: A acoperit cu ape pe duşmani, apoi din adâncurile mării i-a aruncat afară.
translations.grk: Τοὺς δὲ ἐχθροὺς αὐτῶν κατέκλυσε, καὶ ἐκ βάθους ἀβύσσου ἀνέβρασεν αὐτούς.

verses.geez: ወአዕደወቶሙ፡ ባሕረ፡ መፍርሀ፡ ወአኀለፈቶሙ፡ እምተ፡ ማእከለ፡ ማይ፡ ብዙኅ።
verses.translation: Therefore the righteous spoiled the ungodly, and praised thy holy name, O Lord, and magnified with one accord thine hand, that fought for them.

translations.lxx: Therefore the righteous spoiled the ungodly, and praised thy holy name, O Lord, and magnified with one accord thine hand, that fought for them.
translations.ron: Pentru aceea, drepţii au jefuit pe cei necredincioşi şi au slăvit cântând numele Tău cel sfânt, Stăpâne, şi toţi laolaltă au lăudat mâna Ta care lupta pentru ei.
translations.grk: Διὰ τοῦτο δίκαιοι ἐσκύλευσαν ἀσεβεῖς, καὶ ὕμνησαν Κύριε τὸ ὄνομα τὸ ἅγιόν σου, τήν τε ὑπέρμαχόν σου χεῖρα ᾔνεσαν ὁμοθυμαδόν.

verses.geez: ወፀሮሙሰ፡ አስጠመት፡ ወአዕረገቶሙ፡ እማዕምቀ፡ ቀላይ።
verses.translation: For wisdom opened the mouth of the dumb, and made the tongues of them that cannot speak eloquent.

translations.lxx: For wisdom opened the mouth of the dumb, and made the tongues of them that cannot speak eloquent.
translations.ron: Căci înţelepciunea a deschis gura celor muţi şi limba pruncilor a făcut-o bine grăitoare.
translations.grk: Ὅτι ἡ σοφία ἤνοιξε στόμα κωφῶν, καὶ γλώσσας νηπίων ἔθηκε τρανάς.

verses.geez: ወበእንተዝ፡ ጻድቃን፡ ማህረኩ፡ ረሲዐነ፡ ወአእኰቱ፡ እግዚኦ፡ ስመከ፡ ቅዱሰ።
ወእዴከ፡ መስተቃትልተ፡ ወመዋዒተ፡ ሰብሑ፡ ኅቡረ፡ እስመ፡ ጥበብ፡ ከሠተት፡ አፈ፡ በሀማን፡ ወረሰየት፡ ልሳነ፡ ሕፃናት፡ ርቱዐ፡ ነባቤ።
